title: AI & Machine Learning
summary: Explore how learning methods and modern AI connect to statistical, computational, and responsible-practice foundations.
applications: Evaluate a predictive model for a domain problem
Study reliability and fairness of an AI-assisted workflow

capstone.title: Reliable AI for a real decision
capstone.summary: Example GRAD 5800 topic: compare a predictive model with a generative-AI-assisted workflow for a clearly defined domain task, including uncertainty, evaluation, and responsible use. Confirm project scope, data access, and supervision with the program.
questions: What does the AI workflow improve compared with a statistical or computational baseline?
How will performance, uncertainty, failures, and fairness be evaluated?
Which decisions require domain expertise or human review?

title: Sports Analytics
summary: Connect prediction, causal questions, visualization, and decisions to sports problems.
applications: Evaluate a sports decision or intervention

capstone.title: Forecasting and decisions in a sports organization
capstone.summary: Example GRAD 5800 topic: use publicly available or approved sports data to investigate a forecasting and decision problem, such as event demand or team-performance trends. Connect the analysis to sport-management context; confirm data access, scope, and supervision with the program.
questions: Which sports decision will the forecast or analysis inform?
How will time dependence, uncertainty, and predictive leakage be handled?
What contextual factors or ethical constraints limit the recommendation?

title: Business & Decision Analytics

applications: Build a decision-support analysis or dashboard

capstone.title: Evidence-based customer or operational decisions

title: Health & Biostatistics
